_comment: Frozen retrieval configuration for main runs. Verified by agent/test_retrieval.py (lock checks below fail the run on drift). Sits alongside the prereg artifact lock; cite in prereg v0.9.
status: candidate-frozen: guards the registered 25-card library cards/cards_v1.0.json (byte-hash below); re-locked at the W10/W10b advice re-issue (static-only validation advice; no cards added, none fitted to a task). Formal v1.0/pre-main lock pending.
query_source: latest_hypothesis_text; empty (before the first hypothesis) returns [] -- retrieval is hypothesis-keyed, no first-k surface
query_note: MVP query construction is the latest hypothesis text only (agent/policy.py). The richer state-to-query template of prereg §5.4 (recent observations + candidate strings + runtime results + uncertainty) is future richer retrieval, NOT in the MVP; this is recorded in prereg §5.4 (v0.7).
trigger_policy: per_step, A1 and A2 (observation-keyed; per-step retrieved_cards recorded in the trace)
_regression_note: query -> ordered top-3 card_ids on the locked library. Recompute ONLY when a retrieval algorithm change or an intended LIBRARY change is made; otherwise a diff here means unintended ranker drift. W10/W10b recompute (intended, advice-field edit): 5 of the 6 vectors are byte-identical with the 2026-07-06 lock; 'silent validation wrong input no output baseline' permuted within the same three silent_validation_failure cards, whose text was re-scoped to the static reading. W10c: the comprehend_time_fixation vector was REMOVED with its family; the remaining five are unchanged from this session's recompute.
_policy_note: retrieval_policy_method_sha256 hashes ClaudePolicy._retrieve_for_step (query = latest hypothesis; inject-on-ID-change). Bump retrieval_policy_version when the retrieval trigger/query/reinjection policy changes.
_w10_note: retrieval_py_sha256 and retrieval_policy_method_sha256 are UNCHANGED: W10 edited the card library only, not the ranker or the retrieval trigger/query policy. retrieval_algorithm_version and retrieval_policy_version therefore stay at 2.
